stable.notes: * The plugin now updates itself. New versions appear under Dashboard → Updates like any other plugin, and install automatically if you turn on "Enable auto-updates" for Tom Moving Estimate on the Plugins page. The staging site gets new versions first; the live site only gets a version after it has been checked on staging.
